source: Town of Moraga Municipal Code Title 8 (https://library.municode.com/ca/moraga/codes/municipal_code?nodeId=MOCA_TIT8PLZO); Moraga Housing Element (https://www.moraga.ca.us/DocumentCenter/View/7078/Appendix-B-Housing-Sites-Inventory-PDF); Moraga Center Specific Plan (https://www.moraga.ca.us/177/Moraga-Center-Specific-Plan-Implementati); Housing Zoning Code Amendments (https://www.moraga.ca.us/DocumentCenter/View/9791/Housing-Zoning-Code-Amendments)

MOSO-OS.description: MOSO Open Space District. Hillside open space, limited to 1 du/20 ac under Moraga Open Space Ordinance.

N-OS.description: Non-MOSO Open Space District. Open space and agriculture; residential requires conditional use permit.

1-DUA.description: One Dwelling Unit Per Acre Residential District. Low density single-family, max 1 du/ac.

2-DUA.description: Two Dwelling Units Per Acre Residential District. Low density single-family, max 2 du/ac.

3-DUA.description: Three Dwelling Units Per Acre Residential District. Low density single-family, max 3 du/ac.

6-DUA.description: Six Dwelling Units Per Acre Residential District. Low-medium density single-family, max 6 du/ac.

R-6.description: Residential 6 District (Moraga Center area). Up to 6 du/ac; allows mixed residential types.

R-12.description: Residential 12 District (Moraga Center area). Medium density, up to 12 du/ac.

R-20.description: Residential 20 District. High density, up to 20 du/ac (or 30 du/ac for senior housing).

R-20B.description: Residential 20B District. High density variant, up to 20 du/ac.

R-24.description: Residential 24 District. High density, up to 24 du/ac.

CC.description: Community Commercial District. Commercial retail and services.

LC.description: Limited Commercial District. Limited retail, office, and service uses.

SO.description: Suburban Office District. Office and professional uses.

COL.description: College District. Saint Mary's College campus; institutional uses.

Institutional.description: Institutional. Schools, churches, government, and public facility uses. No standalone residential permitted.

MCSP R-6.description: Moraga Center Specific Plan Residential 6 District. Up to 6 du/ac within the MCSP area.

MCSP-C.description: Moraga Center Specific Plan Commercial District. Commercial uses within the MCSP area.

MCSP-OR.description: Moraga Center Specific Plan Office/Residential District. Mixed office and residential within the MCSP area, up to 12 du/ac.

MCSP-RR.description: Moraga Center Specific Plan Residential/Retail District. Mixed residential and retail within the MCSP area, up to 12 du/ac.

MR-OD.description: Moraga Road Office District. Office and professional uses along Moraga Road.

OS.description: Open Space. Public and private open space, parks, and recreation. No residential permitted.

OSM DT.description: Open Space Moraga Downtown. Open space/public area in downtown Moraga.

PD.description: Planned Development. Density set by approved development plan, typically up to 20 du/ac.

R-20-A.description: Residential 20-A District. High density variant A, up to 20 du/ac.

R-20-B.description: Residential 20-B District. High density variant B, up to 20 du/ac.

Study.description: Study Area. Parcels under active planning study; zoning designation pending. No development permitted until study is complete.
